baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ at words 1-2: an intensive blocker stands in relation to good.
baseline_models.mechanism: Repeated withholding interposes a barrier between beneficial gift and those who could receive it.

activation_trace.role: The withheld hand supplies active refusal of giving and makes the intensive surface a repeated practice.
A barrier between a person and what is wanted turns refusal into gatekeeping.
Gift and generosity make the blocked good a benefit capable of transfer.

changed_reading.after: He habitually gatekeeps beneficial gifts, actively stopping their transfer.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مُعْتَدٍ مُّرِيبٍ at words 3-4: adjacent active predicates of excess and doubt.
baseline_models.mechanism: Practical limit-crossing and agitation of suspicion form an outward-and-epistemic conduct chain.

activation_trace.role: Exceeding a limit unjustly supplies the outward breach.
Agitated doubt, accusation, and induced suspicion supply the breach's epistemic wake.

changed_reading.before: He is aggressive and personally doubtful.
changed_reading.after: His boundary-crossing conduct also generates or sustains an atmosphere of suspicion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context turns good into a growing, apportioned provision stream; the preventer interrupts a life-giving distribution chain rather than merely retaining private wealth.

activation_trace.role: The barrier image supplies the obstructing function within the provision chain.
Useful, desired good supplies the broad value carried by that chain.
Stable, growing good makes the descending water a durable source of benefit.
Cultivation and germination supply the conversion from received water to shareable yield.
Apportioned giving names the yield's distributive destination.

structural_cues: 50:9-11 runs from blessed water through germination and produce to provision for servants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies barrier and gift images plus a growth-to-provision sequence; I infer an ecological-to-social flow analogy in which withholding interrupts distribution. The live alternative is that الخير remains wider than material provision.

changed_reading.before: The preventer refuses isolated acts of generosity.
changed_reading.after: The preventer obstructs a generative flow meant to become apportioned benefit for others.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated images of mixed-up judgment followed by unveiling make مُرِيب an active maintainer of doubt-producing disorder, not only its private victim.

activation_trace.role: Agitated doubt and induced suspicion anchor the focus figure in epistemic disturbance.
A mixed and disordered affair supplies the early condition in which truth is not stably received.
Confounding mixture that produces ambiguity repeats the epistemic mechanism around new creation.
Removal of a cover supplies the reversal that ends protected ambiguity.
Actual sight supplies the clarified state after the doubt-maintaining cover is removed.

structural_cues: 50:5 and 50:15 place confusion after rejection of truth and new creation; 50:22 reverses concealment through unveiled sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two confusion images and a later unveiling; I infer that the active form مُرِيب participates in sustaining that disorder. A live alternative is the intransitive reading: he is himself only troubled by doubt.

changed_reading.before: مُرِيب describes a person who privately doubts.
changed_reading.after: It can describe one who keeps truth in a mixed, suspect form until disclosure collapses the ambiguity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The companion's denial stages a causal dispute over limit-crossing, shifting مُعْتَد from a person merely pushed by bad company toward an already deviating, accountable trajectory.

activation_trace.role: Unjust crossing of a limit anchors the conduct whose cause is disputed.
A companion joined to his counterpart supplies the social relation across which blame might be transferred.
Exceeding the limit in disobedience directly echoes the focus transgression while appearing inside a denied causative claim.
Deviation from guidance supplies the alternative account: an established path rather than newly imposed excess.

structural_cues: 50:23 introduces the companion; 50:27 has that companion deny causing transgression and instead locate the person in far error.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies companionship, the denial of causing excess, and prior deviation; I read 50:27 as retrospectively testing agency behind the focus epithet. The companion may be self-exculpating, so shared causation remains live.

changed_reading.before: The transgressor may be chiefly the product of corrupt companionship.
changed_reading.after: The epithet marks an entrenched path of overstepping for which external influence does not erase personal agency.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's form-distant ع و د mapping for focus QAC ع د و rather than the primary transgression branch. It remains anchored to the supplied split root and gains pattern-level support from the intensive first predicate and the recurring-return counter-image at 50:32; render it only as a recurrence analogy, never as a replacement etymology for مُعْتَد.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 3, QAC root ع د و, is also packet-mapped to ع و د B004; word 1's intensive predicate makes repeated conduct salient.

activation_trace.role: Habit, training, and persistence supply an exploratory pattern reading of repeated transgression.
Repeated return to a destination supplies the opposite recurrent orientation: return instead of repeated overstepping.

changed_reading.before: مُعْتَد names a boundary violation as a static trait.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it belongs to a trained recurrence of overstepping, countered by the recurring return of the أَوَّاب.

strongest_changes: Withholding becomes obstruction of a growth-to-provision flow.
Doubt becomes an actively maintained disorder reversed by unveiling.
Transgression becomes an agency question tested within companionship.
summary.what_was_special: The terse predicate chain opened into distributive, boundary, and epistemic mechanisms without forcing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether مُرِيب is primarily doubt-producing or personally doubtful.
How far the ecological provision analogy should govern the general word الخير.
Whether the companion's denial reports causation reliably or shifts blame.
The recurrence outlier depends on a form-distant packet mapping and must remain exploratory.
